fixtures.notes_for_reviewer: Non-ASCII hostname ('ä' = U+00E4, UTF-8 encodes to byte 0xC3 0xA4). Lookup brick's first-pass ASCII check triggers InputError::NonAsciiHost -> Failure(INVALID_INPUT).
Userinfo (@) in authority. After scheme strip + extract_authority, authority.contains('@') -> InputError::UserinfoNotAllowed -> Failure(INVALID_INPUT).
Port specification (:8080) in authority. After scheme strip + extract_authority, authority.contains(':') -> InputError::PortNotAllowed -> Failure(INVALID_INPUT).
ftp:// scheme (plain string, no escaping). detect_and_strip_scheme: not https:// or http://, but contains '://' -> InputError::UnsupportedScheme -> Failure(INVALID_INPUT).
Leading-hyphen DNS label. validate_hostname: first label '-startswith-hyphen' starts with '-' -> InputError::InvalidHost -> Failure(INVALID_INPUT).
